description: Defines the SpdyStream class and related enums and interfaces for handling SPDY protocol streams within the Chromium networking code. Includes declarations for stream states, delegate interface, and methods for managing stream data, headers, flow control, and lifecycle.

classes.name: SpdyStream
classes.description: Represents a SPDY protocol stream, managing headers, data frames, flow control, and lifecycle within a SPDY session.

classes.name: SpdyStream::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for protocol-specific behavior and callbacks for a SPDY stream.

methods.name: SetDelegate
methods.description: Assigns a delegate to handle stream events.

methods.name: OnHeadersReceived
methods.description: Called when response headers are received.

methods.name: OnDataReceived
methods.description: Called when data is received on the stream.

methods.name: OnClose
methods.description: Called when the stream is closed.

methods.name: SendRequestHeaders
methods.description: Sends request headers over the stream.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Sends data frames over the stream.

methods.name: GetSSLInfo
methods.description: Retrieves SSL information if SSL is used.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the stream without sending RST.
